ch16_lab_deployment.title: Quick Check: FTP vs. CI/CD & Launch Errors

questions.q: What is the critical security difference between FTP and SFTP?
options: They are identical, just different names for the same protocol
FTP transmits your username, password, and files in plain unencrypted text; SFTP encrypts the entire connection
SFTP is slower but otherwise the same as FTP
FTP only works on Mac computers; SFTP only works on Windows

questions.q: Why is Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) considered safer than manually uploading files via FTP?
options: It requires fewer login credentials
It relies on version control, meaning every update is tracked and can be instantly rolled back if a bug occurs
It skips testing entirely to save time
It only works for very small websites

questions.q: A live site shows a 404 error for an image that works fine on localhost. What is the most likely cause?
options: The website's CSS file is missing
Wrong file path in the HTML, the image file was never uploaded, or a Linux case-sensitivity mismatch (e.g., Logo.PNG vs. logo.png)
The user's internet connection is too slow
The image file is too large for any server

questions.q: What does a DNS 'A Record' do?
options: Points a domain name to a specific numeric IP address
Automatically renews a domain name every year
Encrypts traffic between a browser and a server
Blocks spam email sent to the domain
The process of buying a new domain name
The time it takes for a new DNS setting to spread and update across every internet provider around the globe
A type of SSL certificate
The act of deleting an old domain

questions.q: What is the primary difference between HTTP and HTTPS?
options: HTTPS is only for mobile devices; HTTP is only for desktops
HTTPS encrypts the data being transferred between browser and server; HTTP sends it in plain, readable text
They are exactly the same, just different abbreviations
HTTP is newer and faster than HTTPS
When a website's CSS file becomes corrupted
When hyperlinks point to pages or resources that have been deleted or moved, resulting in 404 errors
When a domain name expires
A type of malware that infects old websites

questions.q: A QA test reveals that body text is light gray on a white background. Which Google Lighthouse score will drop as a result?
options: SEO
Accessibility, due to low color contrast
Best Practices
Performance

questions.q: Why does the chapter single out Safari as the most critical browser to test before launch?
options: Safari is the most popular browser worldwide
Safari on iOS/macOS uses its own rendering engine (WebKit) and notoriously lags behind on new CSS features
Safari cannot display images
Safari requires a paid license to test with
